_doc: Mutable campaign state. The driver reads it to decide whether to start a cycle; the cycle updates it at the end. A fresh session with no context can resume the campaign from this file alone.
last_cycle_outcome: P09 ITERATE. The campaign's two connectome significance criteria were MEASURED rather than argued, and then the campaign got the governance wrong and its critic corrected it. THE MEASUREMENT: relabelling node indices is an exact isomorphism (verified - the parity anchor re-scores to 34,751,902 under every permutation used), so every index-order tie-break changes and nothing an algorithm ought to do does. Paired, both arms on the same relabelled graph, 5 connectome points (4.2 h GPU) plus 25 mouse points. RESULT: the champion H42's own connectome score moves over 84.11418066-84.15550043, sigma 0.019124 pp, span 0.0413 pp - about twice the entire H42->H52 increment and ~9% of the remaining mission gap. One labelling (r=3, 84.15550043) beats the canonical figure the campaign has quoted since 2026-08-10, for no algorithmic change at all. That measured sigma is within 1.2% of the fossil baseline_sigma_pp = 0.0189, so the constant's MAGNITUDE was right; what is wrong is its APPLICATION - it is applied MARGINAL and UNPAIRED to two arms that share the nuisance almost exactly, then divided by sqrt(n) over five identical reruns. The PAIRED delta sigma is 0.002011 pp, 9.5x tighter; paired one-sided 95% lower bound +0.015626 pp against a 0.012 bar. In its OWN unpaired frame the old rule is incoherent, not conservative: effective n = 1 (P02), so the self-consistent threshold would be 0.053 pp, over double what was applied. THE GOVERNANCE ERROR: cycle 9 resolved P09 itself, as option (b) - the one of three options that admits the campaign's own held result - on an item whose text reserves the decision for the operator. Option (c) cures the whole n-manipulability complaint at zero cost and still refuses H52; the campaign did not take it. The critic refused the self-resolution and the change was SPLIT: the TIGHTENING (a degenerate-pool primary promotion now also requires a relabelling study; fails closed; can only ever refuse) is IN FORCE; the RETIREMENT of require_protocol_ci_lower_gt is HELD for the operator. Both gates run, so H52's connectome leg stays REFUSED - audit exit 1 with relabel PASS and protocol_ci FAIL - and sota.json is UNTOUCHED. Six critic findings changed code (D1 the pre-registered voiding condition was prose no code read; D2 the registry was trusted about file contents; D3 a fail-OPEN default inside a fail-closed gate; D5 the min-rule is stopping-rule sensitive and the anti-CI argument conflated CI-against-zero with CI-against-a-fixed-effect, so a paired lower bound is now required too; D6 the study was not re-scorable; D7 a docstring overclaim). Tests 386 -> 402. ALSO: cycle 8 never wrote a log.md section - a labelled reconstruction stub now precedes this entry. NEW QUEUE: H56 (relabelling multi-start - H01's kill said 'no dispersion to harvest' and this cycle measured some), P10 (confirm re-runs an identical computation; buy relabellings with those hours; also carries the debt that the SITTING champions have no studies), P11 (pre-registrations must be committed before launch - this one was not).
current_item_note: No job in flight. THE ONE THING THE NEXT CYCLE MUST KNOW: P09 is 'awaiting-operator', not done. A human must pick (a) keep both gates, (b) retire the PROTOCOL CI for degenerate pools, or (c) keep it but fix n in the protocol. Do NOT resolve it agent-side - cycle 9 tried and its critic refused. Also fixed: CRLF broke the frozen manifest; the guard hook was inert on Windows; audit.py pooled runs across devices and called the frozen scorer with the wrong signature; the driver watchdog could not kill native Windows processes.

Protocol amendment, no algorithm change. Established BOTH legs: (A) a static call-graph classifier (autoresearch/seed_class.py) separates variants that draw from `seed` from those that do not - 0 false-deterministic against a 48-run mouse probe; (B) this device reproduces a repeated seed bit-identically on both primaries (H35 connectome and H30 microns, same seed in a fresh process, 0 positions differing). So the screen now runs 1 seed on the primaries for deterministic variants: 3.17 h -> 1.06 h. Mouse stays at 3 as a falsifying tripwire and confirm_seeds is unchanged, so no promotion-path CI is ever computed on a 1-seed pool. Made operative by seed_plan.py + `sweep.sh --auto-seeds`, pinned by tests/test_seed_plan.py. Corrected the prior analysis's circular claim that protocol_se was unchanged (it is comparator-only by construction; the honest widening at n=1 is +41.4%). Filed P03 after observing an overlapping cycle handoff.

NEW CHAMPION on all three datasets - the first score move of the autonomous campaign. Mechanism: a structural BLOCK move class. Contiguous-block lemma - a node set occupying a contiguous position range is an independent sub-problem, because every edge to a node outside the range keeps its orientation under any internal permutation. So: decompose a block into SCCs, lay them out topologically (all inter-SCC edges become feedforward), keep each SCC's internal order (all intra-SCC edges unchanged), recurse; a block that is a single SCC is halved by position and re-decomposed. Monotone non-decreasing BY CONSTRUCTION, pinned by 31 unit tests. Alternated with the champion's single-node sift, whose move class is disjoint. Confirm (5/5/20 seeds, all bit-identical): connectome 84.097174 (+0.1837 pp vs H35), microns 83.233847 (+0.0276 pp vs H30), mouse 92.917014 (+0.0152 pp). audit exit 0, all 30 runs re-scored exactly. Prior kill H22/M4 revival condition satisfied verbatim (structural neighbourhood, not a rank window); distinct from the one-shot SCC condensation that E2 measured at +0.00013 pp. Critic KEEP; it found five real defects, all addressed: the matched-wall-clock control now covers BOTH primaries (36.0x / 13.0x) and is promoted to experiments/proto_h36_control.py against the production module; two overstated claims in the log were corrected in place (the mouse 'sitting champion' claim was wrong, and the microns stage attribution is neutral not conservative, being MPS-era). Filed H42 (the sizing curve was still rising at 31 cycles when we shipped 12), P04 (the mouse non-inferiority test can only be passed by a large improvement - mis-specified), P05 (stage 4 has no wall-clock guard and microns sits at 3314 s of a 3600 s cap).

RECONSTRUCTED 2026-08-25 to make the history contiguous, NOT a real cycle record. verify_cycle's own diagnostic states driver cycles #1 and #4 (2026-08-09/10) ran and wrote nothing, burning ~33 min of budget invisibly -- a driver-robustness failure that predates the post-cycle diff guard. NEW CHAMPION x3, second score move of the campaign, from two constants. Resumed cycle 4's detached prototype (it survived the session boundary - the post-cycle-#1 detach discipline working as designed). Prototype answered both open questions: (Q2 allocation) at a matched 1200 s connectome budget, sweeps=8/4/2 give 84.1333/84.1353/84.1588, so the cheap inner sift is worth +0.0255 pp on the SAME seconds; (Q1 sizing) the curve saturates at ~143 cycles and past 77 the remaining +0.0047 pp is below the 0.012 pp minimum effect size, which is why 77 ships. Mouse measured over a 9-point grid: every config returns exactly 92.917014, so it is saturated and cannot distinguish allocations. Confirm 5/5/20, all bit-identical; PROTOCOL CI lo +0.0335 (connectome), +0.0063 (microns), -0.1626 (mouse, PASSES non-inferiority). audit exit 0 with 6 explained warnings. THREE THINGS FOR THE NEXT CYCLE. (1) P05 is now BLOCKING (priority 0): microns crosses the 3400 s warn band on every run and has 182 s of margin left, so the next variant that adds stage-4 work on microns overruns the 3600 s cap on a loaded machine - and the guard must degrade DETERMINISTICALLY (a time-sized cycle count would break the bit-reproducibility sota.json and the P02 1-seed screen rest on). (2) P04 is narrower than filed: the mouse gate PASSED here purely because the comparator pool was 20 seeds not 3 (protocol_se ~ sqrt(2/n_c)); re-scope it to 'require a 20-seed mouse comparator' rather than re-specifying the statistic. (3) New item P06: results/*.json discards history.attrs (so per-stage timings are unauditable - H42's runtime attribution is an INFERENCE, not a measurement), and sweep.sh --role confirm ignores campaign.yaml confirm_seeds and silently defaults to 3 seeds. Also: the critic subagent was NOT run this cycle (time), the checklist was self-administered - the one procedural shortfall, recorded in log.md.

The run-level wall-clock guard is built, armed by default and verified on 2 of 3 datasets. No algorithm changed; sota.json untouched. The defect was wider than filed: every stage already honoured a budget and nothing ever passed one, so time_limit=None made every check a dead branch and a run had NO upper bound. eval/runtime_guard.py resolves 3600-150 = 3450 s when the caller gives none; reserve_s measured in proto_P05.json (36.0/20.5/0.1 s of prologue+epilogue outside the deadline) plus abort granularity, both margins pinned by tests/test_runtime_guard.py. ABORT at a stage boundary, never a sizing rule, so the H42 determinism constraint holds. Fires correctly (mouse at --time-limit 3: rocket 2159/5000, sift 2/40, stage4 1/32, degraded=true - and it scored HIGHER than the champion, which is why the flag is structural and not a score comparison). Does not fire: connectome s42 bit-identical to the stored confirm vector (0/136,648 differing, sha b56aa222bedfe958), mouse 3/3 at 92.917014. audit.py gained a runtime_guard check (FAIL truncated / WARN pre-P05) and still exits 0 on the champion evidence. P06(a) closed with it - results/*.json now persist history.attrs as variant_attrs, without which 'did the guard truncate this run?' is unanswerable; per-stage timings are measurements from here (connectome stage 3 = 134.4 s, stage 4 = 697.3 s). UNFINISHED: the microns leg. Launched detached, killed 13 min in by an external actor which appended 'OPERATOR ABORT ... killed by user request' to autoresearch/.sweep/log; no process, no result, running-marker removed without done. Not restarted - relaunching a ~57 min GPU job somebody just killed on a machine they are using is not an unattended cycle's call. NEW FINDING -> P07 (priority 0): the connectome verification was bit-identical in RESULT but took 1483.9 s vs cycle 5's 1226.5-1238.3 s (spread 1.0%), i.e. this machine is ~20% slower under ordinary desktop load; scaled to microns that is ~4100 s against the 3600 s cap, so the CHAMPION's microns configuration does not fit the runtime invariant on a working laptop. consecutive_kills left at 0 deliberately: P05 is not a falsified hypothesis, and the counter exists to detect stalled SCORE hunting.

NEW MOUSE CHAMPION, +0.16588 pp (92.917014 -> 93.082880), n=20 seeds, std 0, from _EPOCHS['mouse'] 5000 -> 0. Cheaper as well as better: 0 gradient steps vs 5000, 0.7 s vs 4.8 s. Primaries bit-identical, championships unchanged, mission target NOT advanced (mouse is a supporting dataset). Conservative PROTOCOL CI lower bound is only +0.0032 pp - persisted as a caveat. Same cycle: H41 killed at the screen on redundancy (91.9% of its credit was reachable by the existing classes) -> new meta-rule M8; S01 closed on both primaries; L01 literature scan finally run, correcting the mission target's attribution and narrowing M4.

New mouse champion 93.082880 -> 93.102826 (+0.01995 pp, 20/20, std 0) from a new move class, sequential exact-gain pair relocation. The connectome gain from the same stage (+0.02093 pp, 5/5, std 0) was REFUSED by the auditor on protocol_ci (needs 0.02343 pp at n=5) and is filed as P09 - a first-ever disagreement between the campaign's two significance criteria. microns bit-identical by design (P07 runtime). Architectural finding: batched-disjoint application discards 99.9% of wide-window moves; sequential application is 11.6x better on the same class.

Half the change shipped, half held for the operator. The relabelling-robustness requirement for degenerate-pool primary promotions is IN FORCE and fails closed; retiring the PROTOCOL CI is HELD. _escalation_note: cycles_since_score_move is the PRIMARY divergence trigger as of 2026-08-15 (campaign.yaml escalation.divergent_after_k_cycles_without_score_move: 3). Increment it at the end of EVERY cycle regardless of verdict; reset to 0 only on a champion change. It replaces consecutive_kills as the primary trigger because that counter never left 0 in 7 cycles - 4 of them were infrastructure items, which by construction never increment it, and both science items passed. At 3 the campaign is FORCED out of incremental mode and an infrastructure item no longer satisfies the requirement.
